eld.text: Rowan Kenrith and her twin brother Will were born to a witch who killed newborns for their blood, but Linden gave up her sword's power to restore them and adopted them.
At eighteen the twins set out to find their father, and Rowan realized that the stag they met was her father, who had been transformed by Oko.
Linden used the sword's life to return Algenus to the living, and the shock of learning their origins ignited the twins' spark, so Rowan and Will vanished.

stx.text: Rowan opened a portal and stepped through, Will was pulled after her, and the twins arrived on Arcavios, where Kasmina welcomed them to Strixhaven.
Rowan zapped a Silverquill student to protect a Prismari one, and when she and Will combined ice and lightning, the spells failed to blend smoothly.
Rowan soon chose to live her own life and drifted from Will, who argued with her about her lack of study, until the two fought at the Mage Tower match.
Beneath the Biblioplex, Rowan drew on the power of the Snarl and poured her last magical energy into Will, who wrested control of the Blood Avatar, which killed Extus Narr but severed Will's leg.

woe.text: After the Invasion, the twins unknowingly lost their shared spark as the Wicked Slumber seized Eldraine.
When the rebel knight Imodane threatened Will, Rowan cut a massive rift into a mountain, and she then left to find a magical cure for the Wicked Slumber, though she could not feel her spark.
At Castle Ardenvale, Ashiok and Eriette told Rowan that her spark was gone and that Eriette was her aunt, and Rowan accepted her embrace.

When Will's army arrived, Rowan attacked him with her sword, saying home was gone, and after Eriette was captured, she blasted the floor and escaped, vowing to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine.
